```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Read in Data

```{r}
data <- read.csv("../clean_data.csv")
```

```{r}
head(data)
```

```{r}
data <- data %>% select(-c('row_id', 'service_type_id', 'block_id', 'block_abbr', 'route_id', 'service_type_id', 'property_tag','geo_node_id', 'latitude', 'longitude'))
```

```{r}
data$time_stopped <- data$departure_time - data$arrival_time
```

# Stop time vs. Boardings/Alightings

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = time_stopped, y = boardings + alightings, color = factor(route_abbr))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    x = "Time Stopped",
    y = "Boardings + Alightings",
    color = "Route",
    title = "Total Ridership Activity vs. Time Stopped"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = time_stopped, y = boardings, color = factor(route_abbr))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    x = "Time Stopped",
    y = "Boardings",
    color = "Route",
    title = "Total Ridership Activity vs. Time Stopped, by Route"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = time_stopped, y = alightings, color = factor(route_abbr))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    x = "Time Stopped",
    y = "Alightings",
    color = "Route",

```

```{r}
data$on_time <- with(data, ifelse(data$adherence > 60, 1,
                              ifelse(data$adherence < -300, -1, 0)))
```

```{r}
data$on_time_color <- factor(data$on_time,
                           levels = c(1, 0, -1),
                           labels = c("blue", "black", "red"))

ggplot(data, aes(x = time_stopped, y = boardings, color = on_time_color)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_color_identity(guide = "legend", name = "On Time Status") +
  labs(x = "Time Stopped", y = "Boardings") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
data$on_time <- with(data, ifelse(adherence > 60, 1,
                                  ifelse(adherence < -300, -1, 0)))

cat("NA count in on_time:", sum(is.na(data$on_time)), "\n")
cat("NA count in adherence:", sum(is.na(data$adherence)), "\n")

data <- data %>% filter(!is.na(on_time))

data$on_time_label <- factor(data$on_time,
                             levels = c(1, 0, -1),
                             labels = c("Early (adherence > 60)",
                                        "On Time",
                                        "Late (adherence < -300)"))

p1 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = time_stopped + 1, fill = on_time_label)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("blue", "black", "red")) +
  facet_wrap(~on_time_label, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Time Stopped (seconds, log scale)",
    y = "Count of Stops",
    title = "Distribution of Stop Time by On-Time Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(p1)
ggsave("time_stopped_histogram.png", plot = p1, width = 8, height = 10, dpi = 300)

data$boardings_bin <- cut(data$boardings,
                          breaks = c(-1, 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, Inf),
                          labels = c("0", "1", "2", "3-5", "6-10", "11-20", "20+"))

p2 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = boardings_bin, y = time_stopped, fill = on_time_label)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.1, outlier.size = 0.5) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("blue", "black", "red")) +
  labs(
    x = "Boardings (binned)",
    y = "Time Stopped (seconds, log scale)",
    fill = "On-Time Status",
    title = "Stop Time Variation Across Ridership Levels"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(p2)
ggsave("time_stopped_by_boardings_boxplot.png", plot = p2, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```


```{r}

  labs(

    y = "Boardings + Alightings",
    title = "Total Ridership Activity vs. Time Stopped"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
data %>%
  slice_sample(prop = 0.1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time_stopped, y = boardings + alightings)) +
```

```{r}
data$over_2500 <- as.integer(data$time_stopped > 2500)
print(sum(data$over_2500, na.rm = TRUE))
print((sum(data$over_2500, na.rm = TRUE))/nrow(data))
```

```{r}
data$impossible_ridership <- as.integer((data$boardings + data$alightings) > 0 & data$time_stopped == 0)
print(sum(data$impossible_ridership, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
data %>%
  slice_sample(prop = 0.3) %>%
  filter(over_2500 == 0) %>%
  filter(impossible_ridership == 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time_stopped, y = boardings + alightings)) +
  geom_jitter(size = 0.025, width = 0, height = 0.15) +
  scale_x_sqrt(limits = c(0, 2500)) +
  scale_y_sqrt() +
  labs(
    x = "Time Stopped (square-root scale)",
    y = "Boardings + Alightings (square-root scale)",
    title = "Total Ridership Activity vs. Time Stopped"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
data %>%
  slice_sample(prop = 0.3) %>%
  filter(over_2500 == 0) %>%
  filter(impossible_ridership == 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time_stopped, y = boardings + alightings,
             color = factor(PM_arrival))) +
  geom_jitter(size = 0.025, width = 0, height = 0.15) +
  scale_x_sqrt(
    limits = c(0, 2500),
    breaks = c(0, 50, 100, 200, 300, 500, 750, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500)
  ) +
  scale_y_sqrt(
    breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 30, 50, 75, 100, 150, 200)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("0" = "blue", "1" = "orange"),
    labels = c("0" = "AM", "1" = "PM"),
    name = "Arrival"
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  labs(
    x = "Time Stopped (square-root scale)",
    y = "Boardings + Alightings (square-root scale)",
    title = "Total Ridership Activity vs. Time Stopped"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
stats_data <- data %>%
  filter(impossible_ridership == 0,
         !is.na(PM_arrival),
         !is.na(time_stopped))

pm_over_750 <- sum(stats_data$PM_arrival == 1 & stats_data$time_stopped > 750)
pm_total    <- sum(stats_data$PM_arrival == 1)

am_over_750 <- sum(stats_data$PM_arrival == 0 & stats_data$time_stopped > 750)
am_total    <- sum(stats_data$PM_arrival == 0)

cat(sprintf("PM: %d of %d stopped > 750 s (%.2f%%)\n",
            pm_over_750, pm_total, 100 * pm_over_750 / pm_total))
cat(sprintf("AM: %d of %d stopped > 750 s (%.2f%%)\n",
            am_over_750, am_total, 100 * am_over_750 / am_total))
```

```{r}
dir_data <- data %>%
  filter(impossible_ridership == 0,
         route_direction_id %in% c(7, 9),
         !is.na(time_stopped))

nb_over_750 <- sum(dir_data$route_direction_id == 7 & dir_data$time_stopped > 750)
nb_total    <- sum(dir_data$route_direction_id == 7)

sb_over_750 <- sum(dir_data$route_direction_id == 9 & dir_data$time_stopped > 750)
sb_total    <- sum(dir_data$route_direction_id == 9)

cat(sprintf("Northbound: %d of %d stopped > 750 s (%.2f%%)\n",
            nb_over_750, nb_total, 100 * nb_over_750 / nb_total))
cat(sprintf("Southbound: %d of %d stopped > 750 s (%.2f%%)\n",
            sb_over_750, sb_total, 100 * sb_over_750 / sb_total))
```
